# Templates

One template per page type. Obsidian's Templates plugin reads this folder, and `{{title}}` and `{{date}}` are filled in when a page is created.

| Template | For |
| --- | --- |
| [adr.md](adr.md) | A decision record in `docs/adr/` |
| [architecture.md](architecture.md) | A subsystem's canonical page |
| [assurance.md](assurance.md) | An Assurance Report |
| [history.md](history.md) | A milestone page |
| [index.md](index.md) | A folder's `README.md` |
| [log.md](log.md) | A work-log entry |
| [pack.md](pack.md) | A pack's page |
| [research.md](research.md) | A study, spike or meeting note |
| [runbook.md](runbook.md) | A runbook |
| [testing.md](testing.md) | A test strategy, method or measured result |

The state page and the glossary are single pages, so they have no template.
